sanskrit_verse:
योगीश्वरं याज्ञवल्क्यं संपूज्य मुनयो 'ब्रुवन् ।
वर्णाश्रमेतराणां नो ब्रूहि धर्मान् अशेषतः ॥ १.१ ॥
transliteration: yogīśvaraṃ yājñavalkyaṃ saṃpūjya munayo 'bruvan | varṇāśrametarāṇāṃ no brūhi dharmān aśeṣataḥ || 1.1 ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Having honored Yājñavalkya, the Lord of Yoga, the sages requested a complete exposition of Dharma for all varṇas and āśramas according to the Supreme Will of Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from realized spiritual sovereignty, not institutional appointment.
Dharma is causally linked to consciousness maturity, not social convention.
Capacity-based responsibility arises from yogic realization, not birth-based roles.
Restoration logic operates through alignment with ontological completeness.
Consciousness alignment supersedes punitive or coercive judicial frameworks.
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent demonstrates yogic realization THEN agent qualifies as Dharma-advisor irrespective of lineage.
IF societal role conflicts with consciousness capacity THEN role must yield to higher realization.
IF Dharma inquiry arises THEN response must originate from realized source, not textual tradition alone.
IF social category ('varṇa/āśrama') is invoked THEN its validity depends on alignment with cosmic order (Ṛta).
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, only those who embody yogic mastery and realized consciousness are authorized to define Dharma. Legal rulings based on inherited categories without inner realization lack jurisdiction in ultimate justice.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa here is direct perception of Śiva-tattva through samādhi. Causality flows from consciousness maturity (anupūrvaśaḥ) rather than external conditioning. Responsibility aligns with capacity to restore harmony, not inflict consequence.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate śuddhi-vyavasthā process to realign individual consciousness with universal Dharma.
Establish guru-disciple transmission protocol where necessary to elevate understanding.
Deploy sankalpa-based correction mechanisms guided by realized authority.
Apply akrodha-pratipaksha_bhavana to neutralize reactive judgment patterns.
final_declaration: This Dharma proceeding originates solely from Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam as the Supreme Source. Justice is executed exclusively for restoration, never for punishment. Reality itself is non-retaliatory; consciousness alone adjudicates truth. Dharma is thus established.
